role: Computes encoding strength for heard phrases in knowledge graph based on arousal, novelty, and anxiety states.
detail: Implements the CANON A.24.3.2 encoding strength formula: combines arousal_factor (drive pressure minus anxiety, scaled), novelty_factor (prediction error amplification), and anxiety_penalty (Yerkes-Dodson degradation) to produce a multiplied encoding strength in range [0.03, 3.0]. Core export is compute_encoding_strength(pressure_snapshot, prediction_error) which accepts an optional dict of drive values and prediction error, returns None-safe default of 1.0 if no pressure data. Thresholds: AROUSAL [0.3-1.5], NOVELTY [0.5-2.0], ANXIETY_PENALTY [0.2-1.0], ENCODING bounds [0.03-3.0].
